name: spatial-transcriptomics
description: Staged 10x Visium spatial transcriptomics analysis workflow with human review gates and LLM biological interpretation at every stage.

interface.shortDescription: Staged Visium analysis with review gates
interface.longDescription: End-to-end 10x Visium spatial transcriptomics analysis: load, QC, normalize, cluster, spatial domains, SVG detection, deconvolution (DestVI/SPOTlight), neighborhood enrichment, and CellChat communication. Each stage stops for human review after the LLM interprets the biological meaning of plots and results.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my gastric cancer Visium data at '/data/gastric/GSE246011/' with the staged spatial transcriptomics workflow, stopping at each stage for my review.
Run cell-cell communication analysis on my clustered Visium data at '/data/gastric/proj/results/04_clustering/sample_clustered.h5ad'.
Deconvolve my Visium spatial data into cell type proportions using the scRNA-seq reference at '/data/ref_scRNA.h5ad'.
